entries.ep_001.title: A Rainy Night
entries.ep_001.summary: You enter a quiet cafe after a long day.
entries.ep_001.cliffhanger: Luna says she feels like she has seen the player here before.
entries.line.ep001.n001: Rain taps against the glass as you step into a small cafe after work.
entries.line.ep001.n008: Do you want to talk about it?
entries.line.ep001.n009: Then please rest for a moment.
entries.line.ep001.n010: Strange... I feel like I've seen you here before.
entries.ep_002.title: The Usual Seat
entries.ep_002.summary: Luna remembers where you sat before and offers something warm.
entries.ep_002.cliffhanger: Luna admits the cafe remembers people who need a quiet place.
entries.ep_002.ending: Your cup warms your hands as Luna looks toward the rainy window.
entries.line.ep002.n001: The next rainy night, the same cafe waits at the corner like a light left on for you.
entries.line.ep002.n007: Then I'll make it a little sweeter tonight.
entries.line.ep002.n009: This cafe remembers people who need a quiet place.
entries.ep_003.title: Rainy Nights
entries.ep_003.summary: Luna tells you why rainy nights make her voice softer.
entries.ep_003.cliffhanger: The cafe bell rings, but nobody is standing at the door.
entries.ep_003.ending: The bell rings once, although the door never opens.
entries.line.ep003.n001: Only one table is lit tonight, and Luna keeps glancing at the rain.
entries.choice.ep003.n004.c1: You don't have to tell me.
entries.line.ep003.n005: You don't have to tell me.
entries.line.ep003.n008: That means a lot. I think I can breathe a little easier.
